c1.kicker: For Shopify, Amazon and DTC brands
c1.h1: Get your own product made for your web store
c1.sub: Anyone can copy your catalog. Same factory, same photos. Tomorrow.
c1.lead: This is the route of one product: from the listing you have today to the box at your door. Fast through our white label network, or from scratch when it has to be unique. Scroll along.
c1.monoline: Six chapters. One point of contact. Steffan reads every brief himself.
